test_title: PYST 01: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::? # : JLH :: IKG : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) # = FDG, % = MLG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/764f7fa484dfcdc8b4a428f5c4bcccbac30d26016f3a62a6d2ce0fdc86cce09f.png] 

Does not follow the same logic.

Option 2) # = FJH, % = MHU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29f6280b294ff9b4169351fe6b97238098afd94eb9f39862569e121dbba1e497.png] 

Does not follow the same logic.

Option 3) # = EGC, % = NPL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f9e124d4e861ea36e163057d738d38d287cf04929e6be3267506c7d357b2600.png] 

Follow the same logic.

Option 4) # = DEG, % = NIU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae4ca5bd9fc14dfbfc1d9a3bf7b9dfcb97eb6a6ca29e7768773c461a2103bb9d.png] 

Does not follow the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
